note: Real .glb models. 'models': part ids that have models/<id>.glb (1 unit = 1 cm, same axes and origin as the procedural model for their type, see js/scene/layout.js). 'categories': one base model per category, scaled into each part's procedural bounding box ('fit': 'box' stretches to it, 'uniform' keeps proportions). Fan models are a single fan with a node named rotor; case models may name their window panel side-panel. List every file in models/CREDITS.md. None are used yet: see CREDITS.md.
